metadata.name: ww-breadcrumb
metadata.description: A breadcrumbs navigation element that displays a page hierarchy or custom trail with configurable separators, styles, links, text, and icons.
features: Automatic breadcrumb generation from the current URL
Custom label, link, and icon property paths
Standard, pills, arrows, and underline display styles
Configurable separators, colors, typography, and spacing
Reusable link, icon, and text child slots for item styling

properties.name: items
properties.description: Breadcrumb items used in manual mode. Each item can be a string or an object with label, link, and optional icon fields. Labels may be multilingual objects.

properties.name: mode
properties.description: Controls whether breadcrumb items are provided manually or generated automatically from the current URL path.

properties.name: labelPropertyPath
properties.description: Property path used to read the display label from each item object.

properties.name: urlPropertyPath
properties.description: Property path used to read the link value from each item object. Hidden in auto mode.

properties.name: iconPropertyPath
properties.description: Property path used to read the optional icon name from each item object.

properties.name: displayStyle
properties.description: Visual style used to render the breadcrumb trail.

properties.name: separatorType
properties.description: Separator displayed between breadcrumb items. Ignored by the arrows display style.

properties.name: customSeparator
properties.description: Custom separator text or inline HTML/SVG snippet used when separatorType is custom. Do not create a separate ww-icon for separators; it will not be connected to the breadcrumb.

properties.name: collapse
properties.description: When true, hides middle breadcrumb items and displays an ellipsis between the first and last items.

properties.name: linkColor
properties.description: Color of inactive breadcrumb link text.

properties.name: activeColor
properties.description: Color of the active/current breadcrumb item text.

properties.name: separatorColor
properties.description: Color of the separators between breadcrumb items.

properties.name: iconColor
properties.description: Color of inactive breadcrumb icons.

properties.name: activeIconColor
properties.description: Color of the active/current breadcrumb item icon.

properties.name: pillBackgroundColor
properties.description: Background color for pill-style inactive breadcrumb items.

properties.name: activePillBackgroundColor
properties.description: Background color for the active pill-style breadcrumb item.

properties.name: arrowColor
properties.description: Arrow shape color when displayStyle is arrows.

properties.name: fontSize
properties.description: Font size for breadcrumb text.

properties.name: activeItemFontWeight
properties.description: Font weight applied to the active/current breadcrumb item.

properties.name: hoverDecoration
properties.description: Text decoration applied when hovering breadcrumb links.

properties.name: itemSpacing
properties.description: Gap between breadcrumb items.

properties.name: separatorSpacing
properties.description: Horizontal spacing around separators.

properties.name: separatorSize
properties.description: Font size or rendered size for separators.

slots.name: linkElement
slots.description: Required wrapper element reused for each breadcrumb item. The component injects the item link through wwLink, so use a simple styled container and do not set custom link behavior on this child.

slots.name: iconElement
slots.description: Required icon template reused when a breadcrumb item has an icon. The component injects the icon name and active/inactive color.

slots.name: textElement
slots.description: Required text template reused for every breadcrumb item. The component injects the item label as text.

specifications: Use mode manual when the desired trail is known from the prompt, and provide the full items array.
Use mode auto only when the breadcrumb should reflect the current URL path and project pages.
In manual mode, keep labelPropertyPath, urlPropertyPath, and iconPropertyPath aligned with the item object keys.
For linked items, use WeWeb link objects for internal navigation when page IDs are known; use strings only for simple URL paths or when the target page is unknown.
The last item usually represents the current page. It may omit a link or link to the current page.
When using icons, include icon names on the items and keep iconElement as a ww-icon child slot.
Separators are not slots. Never create a separate ww-icon child or sibling for a separator; the component ignores it.
For icon-like separators, set separatorType to custom and put inline SVG or a text glyph such as › in customSeparator.
Do not put per-item text directly in textElement. The component injects the label for each repeated breadcrumb item.
Do not put per-item icon values directly in iconElement. The component injects icon and color for each repeated breadcrumb item.
The linkElement, iconElement, and textElement slots are templates reused across all breadcrumb items, not one child per item.
